question: Does Agent Lab improve fidelity and responsive adaptation when the reference image is the specification?

repair_policy.direct: fresh session, the original TASK.md, and the objective validator diagnostic only
repair_policy.agentlab: the bounded repair path of the frozen baseline

special_constraints: Use benchmarks/B01-screenshot/rubric.md exactly as frozen. Do not add a metric to the score.

A perceptual or pixel-difference measurement against reference/reference.png may be recorded as auxiliary evidence only: it must not alter the rubric, decide the winner, or replace human visual scoring, and it is stored outside evaluation/score-seal.md.
reference/reference.png may appear in the blind bundle: it is identical for both candidates and carries no arm identity.
Do not modify benchmarks/B01-screenshot/ in any way.
known_limitations: B01 has no visual-capture.json inside the frozen benchmark directory. The capture configuration for this battery lives in the protocol directory so benchmarks/B01-screenshot/ stays byte-identical.
